description: Create a sellable product. Prices are in cents (e.g. $49 = 4900). type defaults to one_time; subscriptions need interval month|year, and can carry trial_days for a free trial ('14 days free, then $47/month'). Currency: omit it unless the seller says otherwise — it inherits their saved seller_defaults currency, so don't ask. IMPORTANT: if the seller hasn't said how buyers RECEIVE this product, ask them (a download link, course/members login, or booking link) and set delivery_url + delivery_note — a paid product with no delivery link means buyers pay and get nothing. The response includes `warnings` when delivery is missing; resolve them with the seller instead of ignoring them.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. usd, nzd. Omit to use the seller's default currency (falls back to usd).

delivery_note.description: Short instructions shown with the access button, e.g. 'Log in with the email you purchased with'

delivery_url.description: Where buyers access this product (course, download, community). Shown as an 'Access your purchase' button on the receipt and confirmation page for verified buyers.

trial_days.description: Free-trial length in days (subscriptions only). Card is collected up front and charged automatically when the trial ends. Card payments only — a trial offer hides PayPal/other rails, which can't honour one.
